## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, colorful fantasy open-world 3D RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- User requested a game “exactly like Skyrim with all the mechanics”; make reasonable assumptions without asking questions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Built **Bloomvale — The Verdant Oath**, an original fantasy setting with original characters rather than copying Skyrim’s specific content.
- Implemented a Three.js/Vite browser game with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a procedural fantasy world, player, villagers, enemies, quest progression, melee and spell combat, gathering, inventory/journal panels, HUD, minimap, and touch controls.
- Fixed movement responsiveness at low frame rates by raising the frame delta cap from `.04` to `.2`; keyboard movement now reaches Elder Rowan and quest acceptance works.
- Verified inventory and journal panels open, and spellcasting consumes mana.
- `npm run build` succeeds.

### Active
- Further test combat and touch controls in-browser.
- Consider addressing the production build’s 503.13 kB JavaScript chunk warning.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test combat and touch controls in-browser.
2. Optionally split the production bundle to address the chunk-size warning, then rerun `npm run build`.
3. Briefly note the original-setting assumption in the final report.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: world generation, movement, combat, quests, and UI logic.
- `index.html`: game UI, mobile controls, favicon link.
- `src/style.css`: HUD and responsive layouts.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `public/favicon.svg`: game favicon.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` shows repository files as untracked, including `src/`, `public/`, `dist/`, and configuration files.
- Dev server is at `http://localhost:3002`; browser testing uses `playwright-cli`.
- A 9-second W hold followed by E now shows “Speak with Elder Rowan” and changes the quest to “Mischief in the Moonpetal Meadow.”
- Touch controls become active after entering the game but are hidden on desktop, as expected.
- The latest build warns that the minified JS chunk is over 500 kB. Earlier browser logs include a `/favicon.ico` 404 and GPU `ReadPixels` performance warnings; several logged TypeErrors came from earlier temporary debugging/HMR states.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, colorful fantasy open-world 3D RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- User asked for a game “exactly like Skyrim with all the mechanics”; make reasonable assumptions without asking questions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Built **Bloomvale — The Verdant Oath**, an original fantasy setting with original characters rather than copying Skyrim’s specific content.
- Implemented a Three.js/Vite browser game with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a procedural fantasy world, player, villagers, enemies, quest progression, melee and spell combat, gathering, inventory/journal panels, HUD, minimap, and touch controls.
- Fixed movement responsiveness at low frame rates by raising the frame delta cap from `.04` to `.2`; keyboard movement reaches Elder Rowan and quest acceptance works.
- Verified inventory and journal panels open, spellcasting consumes mana, and mobile directional controls move the player to Elder Rowan and accept the quest.
- `npm run build` succeeds.

### Active
- Investigate and fix recurring WebGL renderer errors during browser play; latest console shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value')` in `refreshUniformsCommon` after spell/combat testing.
- Confirm melee combat damage/defeats; touch attack was triggered, but health remained `100 / 100` and no defeat toast appeared.
- Optionally address the production build’s 503.13 kB JavaScript chunk warning.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the material/shader setup involved in the `refreshUniformsCommon` error and resolve it.
2. Re-test melee and spell combat, then rerun browser checks and `npm run build`.
3. Briefly note the original-setting assumption in the final report.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: world generation, movement, combat, quests, rendering, and UI logic.
- `index.html`: game UI, mobile controls, favicon link.
- `src/style.css`: HUD and responsive layouts.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` lists project files as untracked, including `src/`, `public/`, and configuration files.
- Dev server is at `http://localhost:3002`; browser testing uses `playwright-cli`.
- A 9-second forward hold reaches Elder Rowan; “Speak with Elder Rowan” appears and interaction changes the quest to “Mischief in the Moonpetal Meadow.”
- On a 390×844 viewport, touch controls become visible after entering the game; forward movement and the touch interact button successfully accept the quest.
- Touch spellcasting reduced mana from `60 / 60` to `50 / 60` after regeneration; melee was triggered but no combat outcome was confirmed.
- Production build warns that the minified JS chunk is over 500 kB. Earlier browser logs also included a `/favicon.ico` 404 and GPU `ReadPixels` performance warnings.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, colorful fantasy open-world 3D RPG in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- User requested a game “exactly like Skyrim with all the mechanics”; make reasonable assumptions without asking questions and briefly note them when finished.

## Decisions
- Created **Bloomvale — The Verdant Oath**, an original fantasy setting with original characters rather than copying Skyrim’s specific content.
- Implemented a Three.js/Vite browser game with keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built a procedural fantasy world with player, villagers, enemies, quests, melee and spell combat, gathering, inventory/journal panels, HUD, minimap, and touch controls.
- Fixed movement responsiveness at low frame rates and resolved the recurring WebGL `refreshUniformsCommon` error by removing an unsupported `emissive` property assignment from a `MeshBasicMaterial`.
- Verified quest acceptance, inventory/journal panels, spell mana use, goblin defeat and XP gain, and mobile movement/interactions.
- `npm run build` succeeds; latest browser console check reports 0 errors.
